final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.timespan), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ts AS ts, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ts, s3.c, s3.share, s3.share - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(share), AVG(d) FROM s5
